_notice: REAL, THIRD-PARTY-ONLY posts, discovered via public web search (no authenticated social API is connected — see README > Connecting Live Data). Mintoak's own official channels (its website, and its own LinkedIn/X/Instagram/Facebook/YouTube posts) are deliberately excluded — the team already knows what it publishes itself; this feed is for outside listening. Dates are the post's actual publish date where a search result stated it directly (dateConfidence: "exact"), or a well-reasoned estimate anchored to the news event the post is visibly reacting to when the platform's own timestamp wasn't visible in search results (dateConfidence: "estimated", shown in the UI with a "~"). Neither is a crawl/discovery date. Engagement metrics (likes/comments/shares) are not visible in search results either, so metricsAvailable is false rather than a guessed number. No Reddit mentions of Mintoak were found at all.
